_about: Suit profiles for the walker model (pipeline/ariadne/models/metabolic.py, web/src/core/models/metabolic.ts). Each value has a label and a source or note.

body_mass_kg.label: PLACEHOLDER
body_mass_kg.source: NASA/TP-2010-216125 p. 11: an average subject body mass of 82 kg (180 lb), typical of the male astronaut population then

suit_gravity_factor.label: PLACEHOLDER
suit_gravity_factor.note: Multiplies Minetti et al.'s Earth, unsuited cost of walking. Mars gravity lowers the cost and a pressurized suit raises it; no verified source quantifies either here, so 1.0 is used and every Mars walk is flagged EXTRAPOLATED.

max_speed_m_s.label: PLACEHOLDER
max_speed_m_s.source: Minetti et al. 2002: the lowest level cost of walking was at 1.0 +/- 0.3 m/s

power_ceiling_w_kg.label: PLACEHOLDER
power_ceiling_w_kg.note: Highest sustained metabolic power per kg of body mass; sets the pace uphill.

station_rate_ratio.label: PLACEHOLDER
station_rate_ratio.note: Metabolic rate during station work, relative to the nominal walking rate.

suit_pressure_kpa.label: PLACEHOLDER
suit_pressure_kpa.note: Used only for the extrapolation flag; 29.6 kPa is a pressure NASA/TP-2010-216125 tested (Table 7).

gravity_m_s2.label: MEASURED
gravity_m_s2.source: NASA NSSDCA Mars Fact Sheet: surface gravity 3.69 m/s^2
